messages.text: I’ll check the new protocol against the nODD geometry request before any scientific outputs are produced, focusing on geometry identity, comparison definitions and statistical controls.

Reviewed `554b087c3c0088773199466a779a580a25841017`. The protocol supports a meaningful, scoped nODD/zero-field-ODD comparison, pending three pre-output clarifications:

- Distinguish initial-ray geometry predictions from verified transported crossings; unresolved zero-signal trials remain unknown. Freeze target region/side denominators.
- Define chords using immediate constructed neighboring layers within the same region/side; do not bridge missing deposits.
- Audit ODD’s sensitive-Si 5-mm step limit and freeze the effective common transport-cut policy.

Geometry boundaries, 9,500-event accounting, fixed response settings, common calibration and independent cross-geometry statistics are coherent. The old ODD muon helper requires geometry-aware replacement.
